name: Elemental Bracers
summary: At Silverwind Refuge, Sentinel Velene Starstrike seeks the hand behind the tainted waters. She asks you to gather intact bracers from hostile elementals so a divining scroll can reveal who summoned them.

sections.title: Tainted Waters
sections.body: Rogue water elementals trouble Ashenvale’s sacred waters. Unlike the wild spirits that belong to the world, these creatures bear signs of conjuration. Their sudden arrival at Silverwind Refuge warns the Sentinels that outside corruption is reaching deeper into the forest’s waterways.

sections.title: Divining the Conjurer
sections.body: Sentinel Velene Starstrike believes someone bound and unleashed the elementals. She gives you a magical divining scroll to identify the culprit. The spell needs intact bracers taken from the spirits before they dissipate. Their lingering arcane signature can lead the scroll to whoever called the elementals into being.

sections.title: A Wizard's Meddling
sections.body: The divining scroll reads the intact bracers and confirms Velene’s worst fear: a solitary mage is churning corrupt elementals into Ashenvale’s pools. The discovery outrages the night elf defenders. They prepare swift retribution against the summoner who threatens the woodlands’ sanctity.

faq.q: Why are there water elementals in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The hostile water elementals are not natural inhabitants of Ashenvale. An outside spellcaster summoned them, disturbing the sacred pools and provoking the night elves.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Elemental Bracers?
aliases: where to pick up elemental bracers
faq.answer: Sentinel Velene Starstrike offers the work. She is stationed at Silverwind Refuge, on the shores of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Divining Scroll?
faq.answer: The Divining Scroll reads the magical signature left on the elementals. Cast over five intact bracers, it traces the arcane tether to the summoner who created them.

faq.q: Why do only intact bracers work for the ritual?
faq.answer: Only intact bracers retain enough stable arcane resonance for the scroll to analyze. Destroying an elemental often damages or shatters its magical bindings, leaving them unable to reveal the conjurer.

faq.q: What happens after divining the scroll?
faq.answer: After you return the Divined Scroll to Sentinel Velene Starstrike, she identifies the rogue spellcaster responsible and sends you to hunt the summoner in the follow-up, Mage Summoner.

faq.q: Why does Sentinel Velene care so much about these elementals?
aliases: why night elves care about elementals
faq.answer: Night elves revere the natural purity of Ashenvale’s forests and waters. A mortal wizard who deliberately pollutes and destabilizes their lakes with corrupted elementals insults their guardianship.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Ashenvale’s natural pools are sacred ground. Arcane summoners who bring foreign corruption affront the Kaldorei.
As a mage, you can recognize how bindings on conjured elementals carry their master’s arcane signature, tracing reckless conjuration to its origin.
As an Alliance member, you strengthen your standing in central Ashenvale’s contested heartlands by aiding the Silverwind Sentinels.
